title: W2_4_OFFLINE_FILE_BACKED_AUDIT_TRACE
fileLocation: GitHub Actions runner temporary directory, deleted after tests

trace.requestId: random version-4 UUID; same ID across synthetic BFF, Nest and PDP decision
trace.append: exclusive file create mode 0600; append, fsync and deterministic SHA256 hash chain
trace.verify: requires trusted in-memory independent {count,head} checkpoint; rejects edits, reorder, truncation, partial records, permission errors and missing file
trace.failClosed: audit append unavailable prevents starting PDP, returning positive operational response or source access
trace.checkpointSecurity: external anchoring NOT implemented; rewrite of both file and checkpoint is outside detection guarantee

scenarios: full synthetic NextRequest to ephemeral Nest and cancellable Python PDP trace
no PII or identity fields even if attackers inject them
PDP timeout denies without reaching any data source
mutation, reordered records and truncation detected with independent checkpoint
poisoned sink cannot recover without reconciliation
limitations: The ledger is a disposable file in one CI runner, not a durable operational audit repository.
SHA256 hash chain without independently secured immutable checkpoint or signing is tamper-evident only relative to its checkpoint.
File fsync does not guarantee directory metadata persistence across power loss or supply multi-writer serialization.
No atomic distributed correlation across production BFF and Nest workers, or independently verifiable real PDP identity.
No real shareholders, actual authorized source, financial data, transactions or accounting workflows.
No PostgreSQL, Docker, external audit service or production deployment.
